records.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: AddGuestsDialog.tsx defines ZAddGuestsInputSchema inline with a uniqueness `.refine`, while addGuests.schema.ts defines a separate ZAddGuestsInputSchema with only `z.array(z.string().email())` and no uniqueness check. Two same-named schemas with divergent validation is a concrete, diff-grounded maintainability/drift concern (the server path could accept duplicates the client rejects). It is not itself incorrect behavior in the UI flow, so not a bug.

records.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — Guest attendee rows are created via prisma.booking.update/createMany before eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees runs, with no transaction or compensating rollback, so if the calendar update throws the new attendees remain persisted in the DB while the calendar/video event never reflects them, leaving a permanent inconsistent state
records.rationale: The diff shows prisma.booking.update with createMany persisting new attendees (addGuests.handler.ts lines ~92-101) before `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` is called with no transaction or rollback; the only try/catch wraps sendAddGuestsEmails, not the calendar update. If updateCalendarAttendees throws, the mutation errors out but the attendees rows remain, leaving DB/calendar inconsistency. This is a verifiable correctness defect in newly added code.
